_note: Librarian capability registry. The output_contract block per entry is the contract-of-record: files-written · schema · validation · failure-mode + the capability↔schema/path dependency map. HAND-MAINTAINED source-of-truth: edit DIRECTLY; no generator regenerates this file (feedback_manifest_no_hand_edit scopes to read-replica manifests, e.g. librarian-manifest.json, NOT this primary registry). Home: skills/librarian/capability-registry.json. 37 capabilities: the 15 built bodies + the 22 ported capabilities (frontmatter-enforce … session-close, ported as-is, with the lib/→hooks/lib/ path translation). The 10 CUT vault/engagement-specific caps (architect-triage, classify, cluster-by-topic, cron-log-architecture, draft-canonical-file, people-audit, sync-check, transcript-mine, write-frontmatter, entity-parity) have 0 registry keys / 0 bodies / 0 SKILL.md headings. mem-promote is a standalone skill (not here); the 4 engine-auditors (active-gates-rebuild/l3-registry-audit/update-harness-validated/parallel-run-audit) are ABSENT BY CONSTRUCTION from skills/librarian/capabilities/. The disk↔registry↔SKILL.md bijection (capability-registry-parity, classes a/b/e) holds at 39 after T-4 added chronicle-index (the live base was 38: 37 .sh bodies + the spec-only review key; the earlier '37' in this note was stale — read the live count, never trust this prose: feedback B2). This count is the live registry length.
